# @openwizard/devtools

A React panel that shows a run's graph, steps, events and history.

```sh
npm install @openwizard/devtools
```

```tsx
import { Devtools } from '@openwizard/devtools'
import '@openwizard/devtools/style.css'

export const Tools = ({ run }) => <Devtools source={run} />
```

Read the [devtools reference](https://abcdmku.github.io/wizard/reference/devtools).
